notes: Sloka 25: a child may be born in the dasha or sub-period of the ascendant lord, the 7th lord, the 5th lord, Jupiter, or a planet in or aspecting the 5th house.

rules.text: The dasha lord rules the 1st, 5th or 7th, is Jupiter or with it, or occupies or aspects the 5th: a period in which a child may be born.
The sub-period lord rules the 1st, 5th or 7th, is Jupiter or with it, or occupies or aspects the 5th: a sub-period in which a child may be born.
